qa_pairs.question: What types of tasks are displayed in this section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: This section of the Metrix portal displays all tasks that a user has launched, including those currently running or pending.

qa_pairs.question: How can users search for or filter tasks within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can filter tasks by their status (e.g., Out of Memory (OOM), completed, running) using an option in the top-left, and search for tasks by Job ID or name in the top-right.

qa_pairs.question: What navigation feature is available for browsing task pages in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can quickly navigate between task pages using an option in the bottom-right that allows for multiple jumps.
